ModulePrefs.title: platform
ModulePrefs.author: Juan M. Aguirregabiria (http://tp.lc.ehu.es/jma.html); Fremont Teng; lookang
ModulePrefs.description: A cylinder rolls without sliding over a platform, which can move with zero or constant acceleration in the direction perpendicular to the cylinder axis. The motion of the center-of-mass and the velocity field along the cylinder perimeter can be analyzed in the laboratory or in the platform frame.
